two_reactive_application.regularity: For AF-CD>0 a regular function needs lambda1>=0 or lambda2>=0
two_reactive_application.exceptional_coverage: The only nonregular five-element/two-reactive exceptions are bridges 70 and 95. Bridge 70 needs mu1>=0 and AF-CD>0; bridge 95 needs AF-CD<0.
two_reactive_application.arbitrary_resistors: Theorem 3.1 explicitly states the Reichert reduction to three resistors; used as an external classical leaf, not independently re-proved.
two_reactive_application.authentication: Same institutional PDF SHA; entire relevant statement and necessity proof read; Table 5.9 and Theorem A.9 rendered and visually inspected.
two_reactive_application.source_defect: Figure A.11 caption incorrectly calls bridge 70 always regular. Do not use that caption. Formula A.252, Theorem A.9 and an exact nonregular physical bridge control agree.
two_reactive_application.secondary_primary_boundary: The original Reichert proof and the 2016 alternative manuscript were not authenticated here. The public Bristol PDF returned HTTP 403. This application cites the exact theorem stated in the retained 2019 dissertation.
two_reactive_application.implication_verdict: verified from the stated classical leaves; full independent/classification formalization remains outside scope
